newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl says euro to strengthen competitive stance.
newsitem.headline: Kohl says euro to strengthen competitive stance.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Wednesday the planned single European currency, the euro, would strengthen Europe's competitive position against the dollar and yen spheres.
In the text of a speech prepared for delivery at a trades' conference, Kohl said speculation about which countries would participate in EMU was inappropriate at this time.
But recent progress in Germany and Europe on fiscal matters was grounds for optimism on EMU's chances for success, he said.
Kohl said stability would not be sacrificed to the common currency, as all Europeans want it to be a hard currency.
The decision on what countries will participate in EMU at its scheduled January 1999 start will be made in 1998 based on 1997 data, he said.
